title: 基于幅度的专家掩码的混合专家模型深度感知敏感性分析
summary: 本文对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型进行逐层敏感性分析，发现MoE层敏感性具有深度依赖性：早期和中间层对专家掩码脆弱，而后期层可容忍激进掩码。晚期聚焦策略在保留质量的同时掩码更多专家，为深度感知的MoE压缩提供实证基础。
summary_en: This paper presents a layer-wise sensitivity analysis of MoE models, finding depth-dependent fragility: early/middle layers are sensitive to expert masking while late layers tolerate aggressive masking. Late-focused policies achieve better quality-masking tradeoffs, providing empirical basis for depth-aware MoE compression.
